boundary_rationale: Onset: 23:36 is a sub-onset — "YHWH said to me" plus the "son of man" address, judging BOTH sisters together (dual/plural addressee, a shift from the prior unit's singular Oholibah address) — whole verse = "וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י בֶּן אָדָ֕ם הֲתִשְׁפּ֥וֹט אֶֽת אָהֳלָ֖ה וְאֶת אָהֳלִיבָ֑ה וְהַגֵּ֣ד לָהֶ֔ן אֵ֖ת תוֹעֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽן (oshb:Ezek.23.36)". This is not a hard seam (the hard seams inside this collection are the dateline and word-event onsets at 22:1, 22:17, 22:23, 23:1, 24:1 and 24:15; 23:36 is not among them); it is instead a held either/or question — its own unit, or the close of the 23:1-35 allegory — rather than a ruled seam. Close: 23:49, whole verse = "וְנָתְנ֤וּ זִמַּתְכֶ֨נָה֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ן וַחֲטָאֵ֥י גִלּוּלֵיכֶ֖ן תִּשֶּׂ֑אינָה וִידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה (oshb:Ezek.23.49)" — ending in a recognition-formula-pattern clause (2mp verb form with the "Lord YHWH" divine-name variant, read directly from these bytes rather than from any pre-counted inventory list), followed by a pe mark (single-witness).

boundary_rationale: Onset: 24:1 is a HARD SEAM — the siege dateline, the 5th of the 14 oracle datelines in canonical order (1:1, 1:2, 8:1, 20:1, 24:1, 26:1, 29:1, 29:17, 30:20, 31:1, 32:1, 32:17, 33:21, 40:1) — and simultaneously the word-event formula with the date infixed between the word for "to me" and the word for "saying": present in the 41-verse any-form word-event count and ABSENT from the strict 39-verse count (the infix breaks the adjacency the strict form requires). Whole verse = "וַיְהִי֩ דְבַר יְהוָ֨ה אֵלַ֜י בַּשָּׁנָ֤ה הַתְּשִׁיעִית֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִ֔י בֶּעָשׂ֥וֹר לַחֹ֖דֶשׁ לֵאמֹֽר (oshb:Ezek.24.1)". Close: 24:14 stacks TWO close-grade formulae on one verse — the emphatic "I, YHWH, have spoken" (14-list) and the utterance formula (81-list) — whole verse = "אֲנִ֨י יְהוָ֤ה דִּבַּ֨רְתִּי֙ בָּאָ֣ה וְעָשִׂ֔יתִי לֹֽא אֶפְרַ֥ע וְלֹא אָח֖וּס וְלֹ֣א אֶנָּחֵ֑ם כִּדְרָכַ֤יִךְ וְכַעֲלִילוֹתַ֨יִךְ֙ שְׁפָט֔וּךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה (oshb:Ezek.24.14)".

strongest_rejected_alternative: Two alternatives were weighed for MT 24:1. (1) Treating 24:1-27 as ONE unit (24:1 as the head of this collection's entire last movement, no further internal cut) — rejected because 24:15 carries its own full-form strict word-event onset (a hard seam in its own right) and a genre shift from mashal to sign-act, and both halves carry independent formula closes (24:14 and 24:27); collapsing them would also violate the granularity target. (2) Treating 24:1 as its OWN one-verse dated complex, separate from 24:2-14 — rejected because a dateline fused with a word-event in one verse is treated as a single onset that never splits, and because 24:3's dateline-day reference (verse-final words "שְׁפֹ֔ת וְגַם יְצֹ֥ק בּ֖וֹ מָֽיִם (oshb:Ezek.24.3)") ties the mashal directly to the date just given, with no seam between them.
